narration_use: reference only when drafting; required units must be derivable from the public B2 inputs (table + intent)
file_naming: one G1 per input contract; B1/B3/B4/B5 need separate drafts
intent: To demonstrate that police reform proposals enjoy substantial support among Republicans and white Americans, even though Democrats and black Americans exhibit higher levels of favorability and intensity.

units.meaning: Among all entries, the Strongly series entry 'Require police to be trained' has the highest relative value (0.3008).

basis.note: Highest relative value in the table.

accepted_routes: Strongly support is highest for requiring police training
The strongest intensity of support is for police training
Require police to be trained has the top Strongly relative value
units.visual_evidence_rule: The visual encoding must show 'Require police to be trained' in the Strongly series as having the highest relative value compared to all other entries.
units.temporal_anchor: the clause about intensity of support being higher
units.reviewer_question: Must the video explicitly identify 'Require police to be trained' as the proposal with the highest Strongly relative value?

units.meaning: The Strongly series entry 'power to investigate and' has the lowest relative value (0.1039) among all entries.

basis.note: Lowest relative value in the table.

accepted_routes: Strongly support is lowest for giving power to investigate
The least intense support is for power to investigate
power to investigate and has the bottom Strongly relative value
units.visual_evidence_rule: The visual encoding must show 'power to investigate and' in the Strongly series as having the lowest relative value compared to all other entries.
units.temporal_anchor: the clause about intensity of support being higher
units.reviewer_question: Is it required to show the lowest Strongly relative value, or is only the highest sufficient?

units.meaning: In the Somewhat series, the highest relative values are tied at 0.2242 (entities labeled '44' and '27'), and the lowest is 0.1695 (entity labeled '26').
accepted_routes: Somewhat support peaks at 0.2242 for two entries and bottoms at 0.1695
The Somewhat series ranges from 0.1695 to 0.2242
The highest Somewhat relative values are tied, while 26 is the lowest
units.visual_evidence_rule: Within the Somewhat series, the marks for '44' and '27' must be the highest and the mark for '26' must be the lowest.
units.temporal_anchor: the clause about fair amount of support
units.reviewer_question: Should the video call out the tie at the top of the Somewhat series and the lowest Somewhat value?

weight_mode_note: every unit gets 1/n so coverage is a plain share; weight_template is kept for per-type analysis only
